extracted.intended_audience: journalists/media and the general public (reporters covering Alzheimer's and health news)
extracted.subtask_description: Organization news landing page listing press releases and providing media/press resources; describes how releases reflect the Association's knowledge, statistics and position and offers assets for reporters. Useful for media relations and for journalists seeking official statements, background, and spokespeople.

rubrics_metrics.name: News releases reflect Association knowledge/position
rubrics_metrics.description: "Any news release posted here reflects the knowledge, statistics and position of the Alzheimer's Association at that time."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placed in the page preface as an explicit standard: news items are intended to promote awareness of the latest Alzheimer’s research, resources and news and to convey the Association’s official stance and current data. Implies time-bound accuracy and organizational representation; suggests releases should be relied on only for the Association’s information as of the release date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a range of press/media resources
rubrics_metrics.description: "Access a range of media resources to support your reporting, including downloadable fact sheets, infographics, videos, official statements, and background materials about the Alzheimer’s Association and our mission."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit guidance about the types of assets the Association makes available to reporters. Implies press materials should be accompanied by supporting documents and multimedia (fact sheets, infographics, videos), official statements, and background information to facilitate accurate reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include spokesperson and media assets (speaker bios, B-roll, celebrity champions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Related quick links list: About, Statements, Alzheimer's Association Celebrity Champions, B-Roll, Speaker Bios, Maria C. Carrillo, Ph.D. (bio), Robert Egge (bio), Heather M. Snyder, Ph.D. (bio), View All Spokespeople.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site signals that press packages and news items should provide access to named spokespeople and their biographies, B-roll footage, and notable champions/voices. This supports journalist needs for attribution, interviews, and multimedia footage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release presentation elements: category, headline, summary, and date
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists items under headings like "Press releases & statements" showing a title, short summary/teaser, and a publication date (e.g., "Alzheimer’s Disease Drug Development Pipeline is Growing..." May 5, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The visible structure implies a standard formatting/presentation for news items: clearly labeled category, a concise headline, a brief lead/summary to explain the gist, and a date. Useful as a model for how the Association publishes and organizes releases on the site (featured items, categories, share/print affordances).
